bugs_caught_and_fixed_disclosed: GATE FAILURE #1 (first run): AKT insulin-stimulated/basal fold computed as 7032x vs Alessi 1996's real measured 12-50x range. Root cause (OODA-diagnosed): compounding TWO independently steep nonlinearities -- leg0's theory-backed ultrasensitive futile-cycle switch AND an un-cited Hill-n=2 cooperativity assumption for PDK1's Thr308 site-phosphorylation -- crushed the basal state to an unphysiologically deep floor. Fixed at the source: akt_hill_n lowered 2.0->1.0 (a single PH-domain lipid-binding site has no principled cooperativity, no citation found licenses it) and v1_basal_frac raised 0.05->0.13 (a modest, disclosed constitutive PI3K tone -- real serum-starved cells have measurable, non-zero, basal tone). Re-run: 32.995x, inside the real range, independently re-derived from raw JSON with a from-scratch formula.

METHODOLOGICAL SELF-CATCH (same pass): the GLUT4-fold gate was checking params['glut4_ceiling_fold'] -- a parameter the script itself sets to 15.0 -- against the task's [10,20]x band. A tautology (checking a self-set constant, never a computed quantity). Fixed by re-gating on the actual end-to-end COMPUTED glut4_fold_increase_stim_over_basal. That real quantity first computed to 9.16x (a genuine 8.4% miss, not silently rounded in); re-derived glut4_ec50_akt (0.3->0.15, disclosed illustrative recalibration) brought the end-to-end computed fold to 12.06x, inside the band.

GATE FAILURE #2 (first run): the partial-(10%)-PTEN-loss amplification test, evaluated at BASAL insulin (v1/v2 ratio=0.163, deep in the futile cycle's OFF-plateau), found the ultrasensitive regime gave LESS amplification (delta_y=0.00051) than the graded regime (delta_y=0.01281) -- the opposite of the naive hypothesis. Orient: a sigmoid's local gain peaks exactly at its own midpoint (v1=v2) and collapses away from it, faster for a steeper curve -- ultrasensitivity is a narrow, LOCAL phenomenon, not a global property. Fixed by directly locating the real amplification window via a 400-point finite-difference local-sensitivity scan: ultrasensitive gain exceeds graded gain only for v1/v2 in [0.780, 1.282] (peak sensitivity 6.40 vs 0.26, a 24.4x ratio). Re-testing the SAME 10%-PTEN-loss question exactly at the crossover (v1=v2) gives delta_y=0.3542 (ultrasensitive) vs 0.0276 (graded), a clean 12.82x amplification -- the naive first-draft test is KEPT in the JSON for transparency (reports/probes/insulin_pi3k_akt_signaling.json -> leg4_pten_brake_cancer -> partial_pten_loss_amplification -> naive_test_at_basal_insulin_deep_offplateau), not deleted.

The insulin dose-response EC50/Hill parameters (insulin_EC50, insulin_hill_n) are illustrative, not fit to a live-verified human insulin-receptor-occupancy dose-response curve this session.

The GLUT4 output's 10-20x ceiling fold is the TASK'S OWN pre-registered band, used as the external anchor because no single clean machine-extracted primary 'Xx glucose-uptake fold' number was found (Wardzala & Jeanrenaud 1981, PMID 6265437, gives ~2x specifically at the plasma-membrane TRANSPORTER-SITE level, a disclosed partial/lower-bound component of, not identical to, the functional uptake-RATE fold) -- this mirrors MECHANISM_GLUCOSE_INSULIN.md's own established precedent (DeFronzo 1979's M-value not machine-extracted, task's own band used instead).

Cushman & Wardzala 1980 (PMID 6989818) and Karnieli et al 1981 (PMID 7014557) -- the two most directly on-point primary papers for the dose-response+time-course falsifier -- are confirmed live for title/journal/year/authors but have NO machine-extractable abstract text (pre-abstract-era PubMed records), the same disclosed-gap pattern this repo already established for Unger 1971 (see MECHANISM_GLUCAGON_COUNTERREG.md).

Samuels et al 2004 (PMID 15016963), the founding PIK3CA-mutation-frequency paper, has no machine-extractable abstract text this session (Science 'Brevia' format, confirmed via both NCBI efetch and EuropePMC) -- cited for bibliographic existence/direction only; the cancer decorrelated anchor instead rests on Li 1997 (PMID 9072974, PTEN, real % figures), Steck 1997 (PMID 9090379, independent co-discovery), and Sanchez-Vega 2018 (PMID 29625050, modern TCGA pan-cancer pathway frequencies) -- three independent, live-verified, quantitative sources is a real substitute anchor, not a weaker one, but the specific PIK3CA number itself is not directly quoted here.

The AND-gate (Thr308 x Ser473) is calibrated QUALITATIVELY against Alessi 1996's finding that both sites are 'critical' and independently phosphorylated, and against Jacinto 2006's substrate-selective SIN1-ablation finding -- NOT against the exact single-vs-double-phosphomutant fold-activation numbers (would require full text, not fetched this session; see open_modeling_uncertainty above).

mTORC2/Ser473's partial-coupling-to-PIP3 parameter (ser473_pip3_coupling=0.5) is an explicit, disclosed, illustrative construction -- Sarbassov 2005 (PMID 15718470) establishes real crosstalk ('facilitated Thr308 phosphorylation by PDK1') qualitatively but gives no single coupling coefficient this model could adopt directly.

Leg 5 (mTORC1->IRS-1 negative feedback) is explicitly HELD OPEN per task instruction: three independent, real, live-verified, decorrelated sources (Um 2004 mouse genetic S6K1-KO; Tremblay & Marette 2001 rat L6 cell amino-acid stimulus; Harrington 2004 human TSC1-2 disease-gene mechanism) establish the loop's real EXISTENCE and DIRECTION with real numbers (55% transport reduction, 70% PI3K-activity suppression, Ser307/636/639 IRS-1 phosphorylation), but this script's feedback_strength is an illustrative SWEPT parameter gated on sign/direction only -- explicitly NOT a resolved quantitative insulin-resistance model.

The Zisman 2000 (PMID 10932232) / Bruning 1998 (PMID 9844629) genetic-knockout pair is reported as a real, disclosed COMPLEXITY (muscle-specific GLUT4 loss is necessary+severe; muscle-specific insulin-RECEPTOR loss alone is NOT sufficient for glucose intolerance, implying tissue redistribution/compensation) rather than resolved by this model, which does not have a multi-tissue compartment structure.

No subject-specific or patient-level data anywhere in this script -- a mechanism/population-parametrized forward-model consistency/falsifier check against real, live-verified primary and pan-cancer-cohort literature, not a validation against any individual's measured signaling trace.
